step1_analysis.description: A sub-block of a GMSK modulator consisting of PMOS cascode current sources and common-source amplifier stages. It provides biasing and intermediate voltage gain for the synthesizer.

paper_reference.title: A GMSK Modulator Using a Frequency Discriminator-Based Synthesizer

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain from LABEL_NET_7 to N7.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. With Vsg=0.9V, Id ~ 57uA. gm of XM11 ~ 570uS. Rout is dominated by XM11 ro (~175kOhm) in parallel with the 1Meg bias resistor -> ~149kOhm. Gain ~ 85 V/V = 38.6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS/PMOS parameters at 57uA bias current. Matches the paper's reported 36 dB gain closely.

unity_gain_bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the AC gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = DC_Gain * BW_3dB. Assuming dominant pole from parasitic capacitance (~10fF) and Rout (149k), BW_3dB ~ 100MHz. UGBW ~ 8 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the parasitic capacitance of the output node N7. Expected to be in the GHz range for this process.

dc_power_consumption.description: Total static power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 75mW is for the entire synthesizer chip. This specific sub-block only consumes a small fraction of that total power.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power consumption, operating points, AC voltage gain, and unity gain bandwidth of the amplifier stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* GMSK Modulator Sub-block Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

XM1 N13 LABEL_NET_0 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N2 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N12 LABEL_NET_0 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N11 N12 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N8 LABEL_NET_0 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N11 N13 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N9 N3 N23 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N10 LABEL_NET_0 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N9 N9 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 N11 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N7 LABEL_NET_7 N23 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N7 N11 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN5 N5 0 1.8
VN23 N23 0 0
VGND GND 0 0

VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VN11 N11 0 0.4

VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 dc 0.62 ac 1
VN3 N3 0 0.62

VN1 N1 0 0.9
VN6 N6 0 0.9

R_N7 N7 N7_bias 1Meg
VN7_bias N7_bias 0 0.9

.control
op
let power = -(i(VVDD) + i(VN5)) * 1.8
print power
print v(N7) v(N9)

ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N7)
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
meas ac bw when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 1n 1u
quit
.endc
